title: Sparkly sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='nori' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2f3b57'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1b2438'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='28' ry='6' fill='#243352' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- nori outer -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='url(#nori)'/>
  <!-- nori edge highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='none' stroke='#3e4f77' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rice ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='21' fill='#f4f6f0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#dfe4d8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rice grain dots -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='49' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='60' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='64' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='56' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- filling: salmon -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='52' r='9' fill='#ff8560'/>
  <path d='M52 47 Q58 50 53 55' stroke='#ffb59b' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- filling: cucumber -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='52' r='6' fill='#5fd47a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='52' r='2.6' fill='#bdf3c9'/>
  <!-- filling: avocado -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='5' fill='#9ede6a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='2' fill='#e4f9b8'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe680'>
    <path d='M20 22 L22 28 L28 30 L22 32 L20 38 L18 32 L12 30 L18 28 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 20 L81.6 24.4 L86 26 L81.6 27.6 L80 32 L78.4 27.6 L74 26 L78.4 24.4 Z'/>
    <path d='M84 62 L85.4 65.6 L89 67 L85.4 68.4 L84 72 L82.6 68.4 L79 67 L82.6 65.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M16 66 L17.4 69.6 L21 71 L17.4 72.4 L16 76 L14.6 72.4 L11 71 L14.6 69.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M50 12 L51.2 15 L54 16.2 L51.2 17.4 L50 20.4 L48.8 17.4 L46 16.2 L48.8 15 Z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- little sparkle dots -->
  <g fill='#fff6c2'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='14' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='14' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='42' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='44' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='84' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='84' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
